subject: English Language
source_note: TIE (2023), English Language Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Manage information search from different sources for lifelong learning

sub_topics.title: Use ICT tools to search for information from different sources
competences: (a) Familiarise with various types of search engines (e.g., Google, Google Scholar, Bing)
(b) Utilise ICT tools to search for general information (e.g., books, journals)

objectives.text: (a) Familiarise with various types of search engines (e.g., Google, Google Scholar, Bing)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Various types of search engines are familiarised effectively

objectives.text: (b) Utilise ICT tools to search for general information (e.g., books, journals)
objectives.assessment_criteria: ICT tools are utilised effectively in searching for general information

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of English language skills

sub_topics.title: . Develop listening skills
competences: (a) Answer questions based on information from presentations/tasks
(b) Practise pronunciation of words from oral and audio/audio-visual sources
(c) Write words heard from oral and audio/audio-visual sources
(d) Reproduce messages from oral presentations

objectives.text: (a) Answer questions based on information from presentations/tasks
objectives.resources: Texts about a wide range of events, recorded materials on various situations, pictures, songs, tongue twisters, and language games
objectives.assessment_criteria: Questions based on information from presentations/ tasks are answered correctly

objectives.text: (b) Practise pronunciation of words from oral and audio/audio-visual sources
objectives.assessment_criteria: Pronunciation of words from oral and audio/audio-visual sources is practised appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Write words heard from oral and audio/audio-visual sources
objectives.assessment_criteria: Words heard from oral and audio/audio-visual sources are written

objectives.text: (d) Reproduce messages from oral presentations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Messages from oral presentations are reproduced accurately

sub_topics.title: Produce short and coherent oral messages with intelligible pronunciation and fluency
competences: (a) Distinguish words with minimal sound distinctions that have different meanings (cut/cat; paper/ pepper; date/debt)
(b) Practise pronunciation with proper word stress assignment
(c) Practise pronunciation of words with short and long vowels (e.g., sit/seat, hit/ heat, pot/port)
(d) Practise pronunciation of unfamiliar sounds (e.g., through the use of tongue twisters, songs, poems)
(e) Practise pronunciation of words with similar sounds that have different spellings (e.g., one/won, ewe/you)

objectives.text: (a) Distinguish words with minimal sound distinctions that have different meanings (cut/cat; paper/ pepper; date/debt)
objectives.teaching_methods: Word cards, Tongue twisters, Minimal pairs games
objectives.resources: Dictionaries, speakers, written texts, recorded materials on various situations, cards, tongue twisters
objectives.assessment_criteria: Words with minimal sound distinctions that have different meanings are distinguished correctly

objectives.text: (b) Practise pronunciation with proper word stress assignment
objectives.assessment_criteria: Pronunciation with proper word stress assignment is practised appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Practise pronunciation of words with short and long vowels (e.g., sit/seat, hit/ heat, pot/port)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Pronunciation of words with short and long vowels is practised appropriately

objectives.text: (d) Practise pronunciation of unfamiliar sounds (e.g., through the use of tongue twisters, songs, poems)
objectives.teaching_methods: Information search, Tongue twisters, Songs, Poems, Mimic
objectives.assessment_criteria: Pronunciation of unfamiliar sounds is practised appropriately through the use of various techniques

objectives.text: (e) Practise pronunciation of words with similar sounds that have different spellings (e.g., one/won, ewe/you)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Pronunciation of words with similar sounds but different spellings is practised appropriately

sub_topics.title: Develop vocabulary from conversations and written texts
competences: (a) Write new vocabulary from conversations and written texts on particular topics (e.g., politics, sports, tourism, agriculture)
(b) Construct sentences using vocabulary acquired from conversations and written texts
(c) Play vocabulary building games using digital and non-digital resources (e.g., word board games, charades, picture games, flash cards)

objectives.text: (a) Write new vocabulary from conversations and written texts on particular topics (e.g., politics, sports, tourism, agriculture)
objectives.resources: Audio and audio-visual materials, texts of different types, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: New vocabulary from conversations and written texts on particular topics are written correctly

objectives.text: (b) Construct sentences using vocabulary acquired from conversations and written texts
objectives.teaching_methods: Dialogue, Debate, Spotting words, Close reading
objectives.assessment_criteria: Sentences are constructed correctly using vocabulary acquired from conversations and written texts

objectives.text: (c) Play vocabulary building games using digital and non-digital resources (e.g., word board games, charades, picture games, flash cards)
objectives.teaching_methods: Games, Questions and answers, Collaborative practice
objectives.assessment_criteria: Vocabulary building games are played accurately using digital and non-digital resources

sub_topics.title: Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and in written language tasks
competences: (a) Express ideas or opinions in contextualised oral and written language tasks using proper grammar and vocabulary (e.g hospital, market, library, bus stop, sport and games)

(b) Construct sentences using appropriate grammar and vocabulary relating to a specific context (structure: tenses – simple past, simple present, articles, present progressive, pronouns, coordinators, prepositions, adjectives, adverbs)
(c) Debate on topics using proper grammar and vocabulary

objectives.text: (a) Express ideas or opinions in contextualised oral and written language tasks using proper grammar and vocabulary (e.g hospital, market, library, bus stop, sport and games)
objectives.resources: Audio and audio-visual materials (audio clips, recorded stories), texts of different types, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: Ideas or opinions are expressed correctly in contextualised oral and written language tasks using proper grammar and vocabulary

objectives.text: (b) Construct sentences using appropriate grammar and vocabulary relating to a specific context (structure: tenses – simple past, simple present, articles, present progressive, pronouns, coordinators, prepositions, adjectives, adverbs)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Sentences are constructed correctly using appropriate grammar and vocabulary relating to a specific context

objectives.text: (c) Debate on topics using proper grammar and vocabulary
objectives.assessment_criteria: Topics are debated appropriately using proper grammar and vocabulary

sub_topics.title: Read texts for comprehension
competences: (a) Sequence the order of events in stories
(b) Make a summary of stories
(c) Retell stories

objectives.text: (a) Sequence the order of events in stories
objectives.teaching_methods: Reading stories, Filling the missing parts, Strip story, Story completion, Jumbled texts
objectives.resources: A variety of texts, selected class readers, newspaper articles, journals, encyclopaedia
objectives.assessment_criteria: The order of events in a story is sequenced logically

objectives.text: (b) Make a summary of stories
objectives.assessment_criteria: Stories are summarised correctly

objectives.text: (c) Retell stories
objectives.assessment_criteria: Stories are retold accordingly

sub_topics.title: Comprehend oral messages with increasing difficulty
competences: (a) Paraphrase various oral messages from different contexts
(b) Respond to oral messages from different contexts
(c) Respond to questions about oral messages

objectives.text: (a) Paraphrase various oral messages from different contexts
objectives.resources: Oral and written texts, audio and audio-visual materials (audio clips, recorded stories),
objectives.assessment_criteria: Various oral messages are paraphrased appropriately from different contexts

objectives.text: (b) Respond to oral messages from different contexts
objectives.assessment_criteria: Oral messages from different contexts are responded to correctly

objectives.text: (c) Respond to questions about oral messages
objectives.assessment_criteria: Questions about oral messages are responded to correctly

sub_topics.title: Respond appropriately in a variety of oral and written communication contexts
competences: (a) Express ideas and opinions in different interpersonal communication settings (e.g., I think…, I guess…, In my opinion…, I would say …)
(b) Use appropriate non-verbal cues in interpersonal communication
(c) Use proper grammar and vocabulary in different interpersonal communication contexts (e.g., greetings, biding farewell, apologising)
(d) Use appropriate language and expressions in communicating with people of different age groups and statuses (e.g., peers, elders, family members, leaders)

objectives.text: (a) Express ideas and opinions in different interpersonal communication settings (e.g., I think…, I guess…, In my opinion…, I would say …)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Ideas and opinions are expressed correctly in different interpersonal communication settings

objectives.text: (b) Use appropriate non-verbal cues in interpersonal communication
objectives.assessment_criteria: Appropriate non-verbal cues are used correctly in interpersonal communication

objectives.text: (c) Use proper grammar and vocabulary in different interpersonal communication contexts (e.g., greetings, biding farewell, apologising)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Grammar and vocabulary are used correctly in different interpersonal communication contexts

objectives.text: (d) Use appropriate language and expressions in communicating with people of different age groups and statuses (e.g., peers, elders, family members, leaders)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Appropriate language and expressions are used with different age groups and statuses

sub_topics.title: Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary for oral communication in a variety of contexts
competences: (a) Express daily routines (structure: present simple)
(b) Express ongoing activities (structure: present progressive)
(c) Express family relationship and occupations (structure: present simple+progressive)
(d) Express ownership/ possession (structure: have/has in present simple and had in past simple, apostrophe, possessive pronouns)
(e) Give directions

objectives.text: (a) Express daily routines (structure: present simple)
objectives.resources: Dictionaries, relevant texts, pictures, maps of various places (e.g., school, village)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Daily routines are expressed correctly

objectives.text: (b) Express ongoing activities (structure: present progressive)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Ongoing activities are expressed correctly

objectives.text: (c) Express family relationship and occupations (structure: present simple+progressive)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Songs and games, Matching, The use of pictures, Real-life expression
objectives.assessment_criteria: Family relationship and occupations are expressed correctly

objectives.text: (d) Express ownership/ possession (structure: have/has in present simple and had in past simple, apostrophe, possessive pronouns)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Ownership/ possession is expressed correctly

objectives.text: (e) Give directions
objectives.teaching_methods: Information search, Map reading, Group work
objectives.assessment_criteria: Directions are given appropriately

sub_topics.title: Create a variety of texts for different communicative purposes using the appropriate tone and register
competences: (a) Recognise the main stages of writing texts (e.g., pre-writing, drafting, revising, editing)
(b) Write a variety of friendly letters and invitations (vocabulary: Dear Father/ Uncle, Dear Mother/Aunt, Mr/Mrs…, Dr./ Prof./Madam/Ms …)
(c) Create dialogues on various topics (e.g., the value of education, environment, culture, gender equality)
(d) Create and express orally daily and weekly timetables for routines

objectives.text: (a) Recognise the main stages of writing texts (e.g., pre-writing, drafting, revising, editing)
objectives.resources: Relevant texts, dictionaries, samples of friendly letters and invitations
objectives.assessment_criteria: The stages of writing texts are recognised appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Write a variety of friendly letters and invitations (vocabulary: Dear Father/ Uncle, Dear Mother/Aunt, Mr/Mrs…, Dr./ Prof./Madam/Ms …)
objectives.assessment_criteria: A variety of friendly letters and invitations are written correctly with appropriate vocabulary

objectives.text: (c) Create dialogues on various topics (e.g., the value of education, environment, culture, gender equality)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Observation, Pair work, Act it out
objectives.assessment_criteria: Dialogues on various topics are created appropriately

objectives.text: (d) Create and express orally daily and weekly timetables for routines
objectives.teaching_methods: Real-life expression, Inquiry, Interview, Planning and preparing
objectives.assessment_criteria: Daily and weekly time-tables for routines are created and expressed correctly
